item.title: [DE|Local] BR24 Thema des Tages (Bayern) (Sun 10:00): Das Wichtigste am Sonntagmorgen: Bundespolitik blickt auf die Wahlen in Berlin und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
item.description:
Originally published Sun 20 Sep 2026 10:00 IDT.
Zwei Wochen nach der Wahl in Sachsen-Anhalt wird heute wieder gewählt: in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern der Landtag. In Berlin das Abgeordnetenhaus. Die Regierungsparteien im Bund blicken mit Spannung auf die Wahlen, schließlich steht Bundeskanzler Merz nach dem Erstarken der AfD und dem schwachen Abschneiden der CDU unter Druck.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Mon 07:46): Elections pile pressure on German Chancellor
item.description:
Originally published Mon 21 Sep 2026 07:46 IDT.

Chancellor Friedrich Merz calls a state election result in Germany a "disaster" for his ruling CDU party but vows to remain in office. Preliminary results indicate the CDU has suffered heavy losses to the far-right AfD party in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, while in Berlin it was defeated by the far-left party Die Linke. Also: US officials say 18 suspects in the assassination of the Haitian president Juvenal Moise five years ago are being extradicted to Florida to face trial. The sister of Pakistan's imprisoned former prime minister, Imran Khan, has been arrested ahead of planned opposition protests. President Trump speaks about plans to turn his triumphal arch in Washington DC into a military complex. In Indonesia, BBC Eye investigates allegations of sexual abuse at a  prominent  Islamic boarding school. And Earl Spencer says the treatment by the press of Prince Harry and his wife Meghan echoes that of his sister Princess Diana before she died in a car crash.
